By morning, the bottle was empty, the sea was calm, and the kitchen smelled of the bread she used to bake.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把空荡的街道染成淡金色，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下潮湿的光。早餐铺里亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃升腾。有人拖着行李赶路，有人在医院窗前等待。远处，一声鸟鸣穿过楼群，天边便有了细小的裂缝。夜色还未退尽，生活已经轻轻翻身。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, such as finding an empty box, so you do not keep going forever."}
